label: Meeting Agenda
description: Create meeting agendas, prep notes, goals, and decision points.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to prepare for a meeting.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for deep technical implementation.

label: Meeting Notes
description: Summarize meeting notes into decisions, action items, owners, and follow-ups.

classifier.useWhen: User provides transcript or notes and asks for structured meeting output.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal transcript certification.

label: Scheduling Plan
description: Plan schedule options, sequencing, reminders, or coordination logistics.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to organize timing, schedules, or calendar-style plans.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for product roadmap strategy.

label: Follow-Up Drafting
description: Draft follow-up messages, reminders, and action-item communications.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for follow-up after meetings, support, sales, or project work.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to make technical changes.

label: Task Planning
description: Organize tasks, owners, deadlines, and dependencies.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to organize work into tasks.

label: Inbox Triage
description: Triage messages, requests, priorities, and responses.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to sort or prioritize inbox-like items.

label: Decision Log
description: Create or update decision logs, owners, and rationale.

label: Project Status
description: Draft project status updates, risks, and next steps.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for formal financial forecast.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to remember or schedule follow-ups.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for durable memory update only.

label: Handoff Preparation
description: Prepare handoff notes, context, decisions, and open items.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to hand work to another person or team.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for public release notes.
